capabilities: convert a Kanban plugin board into one note per card and a .base file
map card columns, dates, tags and inline fields to note properties
update notes that a card links to instead of creating copies
preview the conversion with warnings before running it
undo the last conversion and restore linked notes' properties
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.14 or later (the release with the native Kanban view for Bases). The settings tab and post-conversion dialog contain a static promotion for the author's Brievora vault product; nothing is loaded from the network.
problem: The Kanban plugin keeps a whole board in a single Markdown file, while the native Bases Kanban view expects one note per card with columns as property values, so existing boards cannot be used in the new view.

relations.evidence: turns a board made with the community Kanban plugin into one note per card
Other plugins' card formats are not converted, except the due date of the Tasks plugin

summary: Conversion tool that turns a Kanban plugin board into one note per card plus a .base file that opens in Obsidian's native Kanban view.
